# C02-02 — Selective intake and gaps

Status: verified

- Requirements: ST-002, ST-013
- Evaluations: EV-005, EV-007
- Inputs: classified context, persisted project decisions, scope and unresolved gaps
- Output: short, targeted questions plus recorded answers and gaps with owner and impact
- Dependencies: C02-01, C01-02, C01-03
- Acceptance: ask only about relevant inferences and missing information; retain current answers across sessions; block only the affected scope for blocking gaps
- Verification: 6 focused tests cover short delta batches, scoped gaps, accumulated scope decisions, persisted re-entry, material subject changes, and validation; independent review confirmed closure of all P1/P2 findings
- Limit: no repeated interview for valid persisted decisions; no project-wide block for unrelated gaps
